name: Nevada caselaw — CAP jurisdiction collection — 1865–2019 (part-0001)
description: 13707 historical CAP case records, selected by CAP's jurisdiction label. Part of Nevada caselaw — CAP jurisdiction collection; see the collection index for complete coverage. Preserves CAP's Nevada jurisdiction assignment: 13,688 Supreme Court records, 18 Court of Appeals records, and one historical Eureka County District Court record. Coverage reflects this pinned historical archive, not every decision issued by those courts. OCR may contain errors; inclusion does not establish current legal authority.
